blocks.content: Quiz: What is a slice in the context of a Zustand store?
Tap an option below to answer:
A separate store you create with a second call to create()
A slice lives inside the same store. You do not need a second create() call.
A slice lives inside the same store. You do not need a second create() call.
A group of related state and actions organized together inside one store
Correct! A slice is just a way of thinking about your store. You group related state and actions together — like entries state with entries actions — inside the same create() call.
Correct! A slice is just a way of thinking about your store. You group related state and actions together — like entries state with entries actions — inside the same create() call.
A special Zustand API for splitting large stores
Zustand has no special slice API. It is just a mental model for organizing your state.
Zustand has no special slice API. It is just a mental model for organizing your state.
A read-only section of the store
Slices are not read-only. They contain both state and the actions that update it.
Slices are not read-only. They contain both state and the actions that update it.
